name: round
expr: r = round(x); r2 = round(3.14159, 2); r4 = round(3.14159, 4); rn = round(12345, -2); s3 = round(3.14159, 3, 'significant'); s2 = round(12345, 2, 'significant'); ss = round(0.0012345, 2, 'significant');
comment: Sig round(x[,N[,'decimals'|'significant']]). round(x) = nearest int (half-away-from-zero). round(x,N) = N decimal places (N may be negative). round(x,N,'significant') = N significant digits. round(3.14159,2)=3.14; round(12345,-2)=12300; round(3.14159,3,'significant')=3.14; round(12345,2,'significant')=12000. numkit previously took only round(x) -- N + 'significant' added. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
